New DraftKings Sportsbook customers, place a first-time bet of $5 or more and get $150 in Bonus Bets!

To be eligible for DraftKings Sportsbook and the Promotion, you must be physically located in AR, AZ, CO, CT, DC, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NH, NY, OH, OR, PA, PR (residents only), TN, VA, VT, WY, WV, CA-ONT or CA-AB (each an “Eligible Jurisdiction” or, collectively, the “Eligible Jurisdictions”). A new DraftKings Sportsbook customer is defined as a customer who has never placed a wager on DraftKings Sportsbook.

Any customer who is found to be ineligible to play on DraftKings (i.e., by way of self-exclusion from gambling, restriction due to employment, or otherwise) may not participate in this Promotion and immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded under this Promotion. **4. REQUIRED ACTIONS**

In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the Terms, to participate in the Promotion, customers must (1) be a new DraftKings customer as defined above, and (2) place a first-time bet of $5 or more on any eligible DraftKings Sportsbook market during the Promotional Period (the “Qualifying Bet”).

Qualified customers must place a minimum Qualifying Bet of $5. Qualifying Bets are bets on any available DraftKings Sportsbook market. Upon completion of the Promotion requirements and Qualifying Bet, qualified customers will receive $50 in Bonus Bets. Customers will be eligible to receive an additional $50 in Bonus Bets every seven (7) days over the next fourteen (14) days after completing the Promotion requirements. Maximum reward of $150 in Bonus Bets, issued as six (6) $25 Bonus Bets over 14 days.

Customers must login to receive their Bonus Bets via click-to-claim. Bonus Bets issued as follows:

$50 in Bonus Bets will be issued as two (2) $25 Bonus Bets upon completion of Promotion requirements and placement of Qualifying Bet. The remaining $100 in Bonus Bets will be issued as 2 $25 Bonus Bets via click-to-claim every 7 days over a period of 14 days (2x 7-day periods). 14 days is measured from the time of customer’s successful completion of the Promotion requirements and Qualifying Bet placement, and each 7-day period is measured as 168 hours therefrom. Qualifying Bet must be placed using cash from your cash balance or DK Dollars. Qualifying Bets are bets placed on any available DraftKings Sportsbook market.

**9. ORDER OF FUNDS USED FOR WAGERING**

Funds are wagered in the following order: (i) DK Dollars, then (ii) Cash in your cash balance.

Promotion Eligible Games: Qualifying Bet can be placed on any available DraftKings Sportsbook market.

**11. RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL OF FUNDS**

You may withdraw funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to the Terms. Should you wish to cancel your participation in this promotion at any time, please contact customer experience at [sportsbook@draftkings.com](mailto:sportsbook@draftkings.com). Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any remaining funds deposited in connection with this promotion subject to the Terms. Any wager placed on DraftKings Sportsbook in connection with the promotion cannot be rescinded once it has been placed. However, any applicable bonus rewards in your account shall be void, subject to forfeiture, and may not be transferred or withdrawn.

merchandisingData.terms:
DraftKings may, from time to time and in its sole discretion, offer a variety of promotional picks, including but not limited to Stat Slice, Gimme Picks, and Boosted Picks (collectively, “Promotional Picks”). By choosing to use a Promotional Pick in your Pick Set, you hereby agree to be bound by these Promotion terms (the “Promotion Terms”). If you do not wish to be bound by the Promotion Terms, please do not utilize a Promotional Pick in your Pick Set. If you have any questions regarding a Promo Pick or the Promotion Terms, please contact support@draftkings.com for more information.

PROMOTION AND ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

Promotional Picks may be offered periodically at DraftKings sole discretion. A Promotional Pick will close once the relevant game or match begins, or when the last Promotional Contest is full. DraftKings reserves the right to open additional Promotional Contests in the event an initial Promotional Contest reaches capacity.

To use a Promotional Pick, players must be physically located in a jurisdiction in which DraftKings Pick6 operates (Most US states; select jurisdictions in Canada - see https://pick6.draftkings.com/where-is-pick6-available). Must be 18+ years of age or older (19+ in NE, AL) (21+ in AZ, IL, MA, VA). Void where prohibited. Any customer who is found to be ineligible to play on DraftKings (i.e., by way of self-exclusion from gambling, restriction due to employment, or otherwise) may not participate in this Promotion and immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded under this Promotion.

In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the DraftKings Terms of Use, to utilize a Promotional Pick, customers must: (1) be a registered Pick6 customer; (2) receive an offer to participate and use a Promotional Pick; and (3) enter a Promotional Contest using a Promotional Pick.

PROMOTIONAL PICK MAX ENTRY AND PICK LIMITATIONS

For any Promotional Pick, customers will be subject to a maximum cumulative entry fee limit. The applicable maximum entry limit will be clearly disclosed prior to entry. Entry fees must be placed using funds from your cash balance, Bonus Picks, Pick6 Credits or DK Dollars. DraftKings may limit the number of Picks that a customer must include in a Pick Set in order to utilize a Promotional Pick. Any such limitation will be clearly disclosed to the customer at the time the Promotional Pick is offered.

PROMOTIONAL PICK MAY NOT BE COMBINED WITH OTHER OFFERS

Promotional Picks may not be combined with any other Promotional Picks or promotions, such as Gimme Picks, Boosted Picks, Winnings Boosts, No Stress etc.

PROMOTIONAL PICKS:

A Stat Slice is a Pick with a promotional adjustment to an athlete’s statistical projection (“Stat Slice”). For example, a typical "more or less" projection of 5.5 shots might be set at "more" "3.5 shots" for the Stat Slice. The specific Stat Slice will vary each time when offered.


A Gimme Pick is a Pick with a significantly larger promotional adjustment to an athlete’s statistical projection (“Gimme Pick”). For example, a typical "more or less" projection of 5.5 shots on goal might be set at "more or less 99.5" shots for the Gimme Pick. The specific Gimme Pick will vary each time when offered.



A Boosted Pick is a Pick that includes a promotional multiplier (“Boosted Pick”) designed to increase the guaranteed minimum payout for a qualifying Pick Set. For example: If a Pick Set includes two Picks—one of which is the Boosted Pick with a 2x promotional multiplier—and the standard guaranteed minimum payout for a 2-Pick Pick Set is 3x, the Boosted Pick increases the guaranteed minimum to 6x. The specific Boosted Pick will vary each time when offered.

The promotional multiplier will only apply to a Pick Set if the Boosted Pick is one of the correct Picks. For example, if a customer enters a 5-Pick Pick Set using the Boosted Pick and has 4 out of 5 correct, and the incorrect Pick is the Boosted Pick, they will receive the standard guaranteed minimum payout, not a boosted one.

PROMOTIONAL CONTEST GENERALLY

Promotional Picks are entered into Promotional Contests (each a “Promotional Contest” or the “Promotional Contests”) that are exclusively available to entries that include a Promotional Pick. Promotional Contests are available until the start of the game or match for which the Promotional Pick has been offered, or until the Promotional Contest is full. Entries using a Promotional Pick will automatically be entered into the appropriate Promotional Contest.

The Promotional Contest will award cash prizes as specified in the contest rules.

In the event a Promotional Pick does not play, the Promotional Pick will be counted as void and your Promotional Contest entry will be scored in accordance with our Voided Pick Policy: https://help.draftkings.com/hc/en-us/articles/20849699930643-Pick6-Minimum-Play-Requirements-and-Voided-Pick-Policy-US.

GENERAL PICK & PICK SET RULES

A Pick Set is defined as your lineup of selected Picks used for entry into Pick6 contests. A Pick is defined as an athlete and your selection on whether the chosen athlete will have more or less than an associated statistical category. Minimum Picks required may vary by contest and jurisdiction. The maximum number of Picks allowed will vary by contest. The number of Picks and amount of athletes in a Pick Set also defines the contest type in which your Pick Set will be entered. Your Pick Set can only include athletes from the same Pick Group (defined as the set of picks available from a group of set games by sport), can only include athletes from the same sport (meaning, for example, you cannot create a Pick Set with both NFL and NBA athletes) and must contain Picks with athletes from at least two different real-world sports teams. Pick Sets cannot contain the same athlete associated with two different statistical categories.

GENERAL TERMS

Promotional Pick and Promotional Contest offerings vary each time when offered. Promotional Pick and Promotional Contest substitutions or changes will be made in DraftKings's sole discretion. See the DraftKings Pick6 terms and conditions for information, limitations, and rules about participating in Pick6 paid daily fantasy contests. For cancellation of a customer’s entry into this Promotion, which is subject to DraftKings Pick6 Terms of Use, please contact customer experience at support@draftkings.com. Upon cancellation of a customer’s entry, the customer may withdraw any remaining funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to DraftKings Pick6 Terms of Use. However, any funds used to enter a contest on DraftKings Pick6 in connection with the Promotion cannot be rescinded or canceled once it has been placed. All promotions are subject to the DraftKings Pick6 Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. By accepting any bonus rewards, registered customers agree to abide by the terms and conditions of this Promotion. DraftKings customers are responsible for any and all applicable local, state, or federal taxes. DraftKings is not liable for computer or program malfunctions nor for errors in bonus rewards. DraftKings reserves the right to exclude certain customers from this Promotion, as well as the right to withhold the bonus reward if there is reason to suspect that their actions are fraudulent or, at DraftKings' sole and absolute discretion for any reason or no reason, it is determined that their actions are in violation of the DraftKings Pick6 Terms of Use, including but not limited to sharing account credentials with other individuals, placing contest entries on behalf of other individuals, circumventing DraftKings age and location verification procedures and abusing the DraftKings platform, the services, or any bonuses, the refer-a-friend program, or any other offers or promotions in any way. Any customer who is found to be ineligible to play on DraftKings immediately forfeits any bonus rewards that have been awarded. Qualifying Bets will be settled in accordance with outcome of the event for which they were placed.
